title: Supreme Court: LeDure v. Union Pacific Railroad Co.
summary: Judgment affirmed by an equally divided Court. (No. 20-807, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 596 U.S. 242).

title: Supreme Court: Cummings v. Premier Rehab Keller
summary: Emotional distress damages are not recoverable in a private action to enforce either the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 or the Affordable Care Act. (No. 20-219, opinion by Chief Justice Roberts; 596 U.S. 212).

title: Supreme Court: Boechler v. Commissioner
summary: The 30-day time limit to file a petition for review of a collection due process determination, 26 U. S. C. §6330(d)(1), is a nonjurisdictional deadline subject to equitable tolling. (No. 20-1472, opinion by Justice Barrett; 596 U.S. 199).

title: Supreme Court: United States v. Vaello Madero
summary: The Constitution does not require Congress to make Supplemental Security Income benefits available to residents of Puerto Rico. (No. 20-303, opinion by Justice Kavanaugh; 596 U.S. 159).

title: Supreme Court: Brown v. Davenport
summary: When a state court has ruled on the merits of a state prisoner’s claim, a federal court cannot grant habeas relief without applying both the test this Court outlined in Brecht v. Abrahamson, 507 U. S. 619, and the one Congress prescribed in the Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996; the Sixth Circuit erred in granting habeas relief to Mr. Davenport based solely on its assessment that he could satisfy the Brecht standard. (No. 20-826, opinion by Justice Gorsuch; 596 U.S. 118).

title: Supreme Court: Cassirer v. Thyssen-Bornemisza Collection Foundation
summary: In a suit raising non-federal claims against a foreign state or instrumentality under the Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act of 1976, a court should determine the substantive law by using the same choice-of-law rule applicable in a similar suit against a private party. (No. 20-1566, opinion by Justice Kagan; 596 U.S. 107).

title: Supreme Court: City of Austin v. Reagan National Advertising of Austin, LLC
summary: The distinction between on-premises signs and off-premises signs in the City of Austin’s sign code is facially content neutral under the First Amendment. (No. 20-1029, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 596 U.S. 61).

title: Supreme Court: Thompson v. Clark
summary: Petitioner Thompson’s showing that his criminal prosecution ended without a conviction satisfies the requirement to demonstrate a favorable termination of a criminal prosecution in a Fourth Amendment claim under 42 U. S. C. §1983 for malicious prosecution; an affirmative indication of innocence is not needed. (No. 20-659, opinion by Justice Kavanaugh; 596 U.S. 36).

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Unsecured Steering Module Electrical Connector (4 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021 S580 4Matic and S500 4Matic vehicles.  The electrical connector to the steering column module may not be secured properly, which can disable gear shifts and/or safety features including the electronic stability program, the driver's air bag, and turn signal indicators.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improper Deployment of Rear Air Bags (15 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Maybach S580 vehicles.  Trim parts on both front seats may detach during rear air bag deployment, which can damage the air bag cushion or cause the air bag to deploy improperly.

title: Autocar, LLC: ABS Modulation Valve Wired Incorrectly (535 affected)
summary: Autocar LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Xpeditor ACX vehicles.  The Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) modulation valve may be wired incorrectly.

title: Piaggio Group Americas, Inc.: Decreased Brake Performance (27 affected)
summary: Piaggio Group Americas, Inc. (Piaggio) is recalling certain 2020-2021 MP3 500 HPE scooters.  The brake hose terminal fittings zinc plating may contaminate the brake fluid, decreasing brake performance.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Seat Belt Pretensioners May Explode (6,240 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Elantra and 2020 Accent vehicles.  In the event of a crash, the front driver and passenger-side seat belt pretensioners may explode upon deployment.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Seat Belt May Not Lock/FMVSS 209 & 208 (14,812 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Range Rover and Range Rover Sport vehicles.  The driver's seat belt emergency locking retractor may not lock as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies" and 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Insufficient Transmission Oil in Gearbox (9 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Huracan EVO and 2022 Huracan STO vehicles.  The gearbox may have an insufficient amount of transmission oil, which can lead to clutch slippage, and in certain driving situations, a transmission oil leak.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Alternator Belt May Overheat Seized Bearing (27,652 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain alternator belts.  Please see the safety recall report for a complete list of affected part numbers.  In the event of the alternator front bearing seizing, the alternator belt may continue to operate, causing the bearing to overheat.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Alternator Belt May Overheat Seized Bearing (6,342 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2010-2023 H3-45, H3-45 VIP, X3-45, X3-45 Com, and X3-45 VIP vehicles.  In the event of the alternator front bearing seizing, the alternator belt may continue to operate, causing the bearing to overheat.

title: Volvo Bus Corporation: Alternator Belt May Overheat Seized Bearing (48 affected)
summary: Volvo Bus Corporation (Volvo Bus) is recalling certain 2020 Volvo 9700 DOT vehicles.  In the event of the alternator front bearing seizing, the alternator belt may continue to operate, causing the bearing to overheat.

title: Arcimoto Inc: Charging System Malfunction (516 affected)
summary: Arcimoto, Inc. (Arcimoto) is recalling certain 2019-2022 FUV, 2021-2022 Rapid Responder, 2020-2022 Deliverator, and Roadster motorcycles.  When the battery is at freezing temperatures, the vehicle control unit may inadvertently disable vehicle charging from a power outlet.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Incorrect Child Seat Anchorage Symbol/FMVSS 225 (466 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022 A3 Sedan and S3 Sedan vehicles.  The child seat anchorage fitting sleeves are incorrectly marked with a different symbol than the one described in the owner's manual.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Insufficient Transmission Oil in Gearbox (8 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022 R8 Spyder and 2021-2022 R8 Coupe vehicles.  The gearbox may have an insufficient amount of transmission oil, which can lead to clutch slippage, and in certain driving situations, a transmission oil leak.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Insufficiently Attached Spoiler May Separate (6,553 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022 Tiguan and 2018-2021 Tiguan long wheel base (LWB) vehicles.  Due to incorrect installation instructions, the accessory rear hatch spoiler may be insufficiently attached to the vehicle.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Insufficiently Attached Spoiler May Separate (275 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain rear hatch spoilers, part numbers 5NA-071-644--C9A and 5NA-071-644--C9X, sold as accessories for 2018-2022 Tiguan long wheel base vehicles.  Due to incorrect installation instructions, the accessory rear hatch spoiler may be insufficiently attached to the vehicle.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Side Air Intake Cover May Detach (2,284 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Western Star 47X, 2020-2023 Western Star 49X, and 2021-2022 Western Star 57X vehicles equipped with side air intakes on the hood.  The stainless steel cover on the side air intake may loosen and detach from the vehicle.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Hydrogen Leak from Detached Inlet Filter (54 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019 Nexo vehicles.  Following hydrogen refueling, the inlet receptacle filter could detach and cause a hydrogen fuel leak.

title: Big Tex Trailer Manufacturing, Inc.: Coupler Improperly Welded (690 affected)
summary: Big Tex Trailer Manufacturing, Inc. (Big Tex Trailer) is recalling certain 2022 50SR and 70SR trailers.  The coupler was improperly welded, which may cause the trailer to separate from the tow vehicle.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Windshield Wipers May Fail (689 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Western Star 49X and 2021 Western Star 47X vehicles.  The windshield wiper linkages may break, causing the windshield wipers to fail.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Unsecured Ground Connection Bolt (21,306 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2020-2022 GLE450, GLS450, 2021-2022 AMG GLE53, 2020-2021 GLE580, GLS580, 2021 AMG GLE63, Maybach GLS600 and AMG GLS63 vehicles.  A ground cable bolt for the 48V ground connection under the front passenger seat may not be secured properly, which can cause the electrical cable to overheat.

title: Columbus Trading-Partners USA, Inc.: Choking Hazard from Foam in Child Seat Headrest (20,526 affected)
summary: Columbus Trading-Partners USA, Inc. (CTP) is recalling certain CYBEX Sirona M Convertible Child Car Seat, model numbers 518000385, 518002153, 518000387, 518002145, 518002149, 518002151, and 519000211, manufactured between November 3, 2017 and August 31, 2018.  A child may pick pieces of foam from the child seat headrest pad.
